description: Count current project text matches and preview a bounded, recoverable identity and source manifest
purposeAndLimits: Exact literal positions and symbol identity, with current-text/freshness coverage.

description: Tree view of symbols in a file, with line ranges
purposeAndLimits: Indexed nesting in one file; omitted/unindexed definitions depend on index coverage.

description: Find callables where control may enter from outside the indexed call graph
purposeAndLimits: Detected external roots and entry-surface candidates; exported names alone do not establish ingress.

semanticFixtureChecks.claim: export named main alone is not an external entrypoint

description: Traverse selected typed relationships around exact referents; recover source separately when needed
purposeAndLimits: Explicit typed graph projections; exact/candidate strengths and folds constrain every claim.

description: Batch related searches, symbols, and source locations into one deduplicated source packet
purposeAndLimits: Batch source needed to explain behavior; source freshness and bounded units remain explicit.

description: Read exact definitions, line ranges, or file export surfaces
purposeAndLimits: Exact source bytes and selectors; aligned compiler bindings are a separate fact.

semanticFixtureChecks.claim: exact current source bytes excluding terminal newline

description: Find current project files matching a path pattern
purposeAndLimits: Current project file inventory, respecting declared exclusions; not just the index.

description: Show evidence already delivered in this agent exploration session
purposeAndLimits: Inspect session receipts; requires an explicit session for suppression of repeated evidence.

description: List methods of one exactly resolved class; ambiguity and missing targets fail explicitly
purposeAndLimits: Exactly resolved class methods; ambiguous and missing targets fail explicitly.

semanticFixtureChecks.claim: method names and lines exclude field

description: Find all files referencing a symbol
purposeAndLimits: Reference occurrences, not executable calls; output pages and index coverage matter.

semanticFixtureChecks.claim: import and call references remain distinct

description: Trace a symbol: definition + all references
purposeAndLimits: Definition plus references; callsite argument claims require their own complete support.

description: Files this file depends on (internal)
purposeAndLimits: Outgoing static file dependencies including resolved imports; not runtime scheduling.

description: Files that depend on this file/module
purposeAndLimits: Reverse static file dependencies; absence limited to indexed/resolved coverage.

description: One-hop module summary: matched files, documented symbols, and file reference dependencies
purposeAndLimits: Directory membership and one-hop dependencies; fixed exact directory resolution.

semanticFixtureChecks.claim: no outgoing internal-repository dependency from core

description: What symbols consumers actually use from this module
purposeAndLimits: Symbols externally referenced through a file/module selection; no ownership verdict.

semanticFixtureChecks.claim: unused read method absent; used write method present

description: Rank symbols by cross-file reference count; a reference metric, not runtime contention
purposeAndLimits: Cross-file reference counts; does not measure runtime traffic or contention.

description: What symbols does this file import?
purposeAndLimits: Imported bindings resolved to files; source fallbacks disclose their basis.

description: Which files import this symbol?
purposeAndLimits: Files importing the selected symbol; not every dynamic loader.

description: All children of a symbol (methods, fields, nested types)
purposeAndLimits: Direct children, including occurrence-only indexed fields; declaration or identifier ranges.

semanticFixtureChecks.claim: field and methods with exact identifier/declaration lines

description: Count files referencing an exact symbol; top JSON rows include exact symbol identity
purposeAndLimits: Number of reference files for exact symbol identities, not call frequency.

semanticFixtureChecks.claim: one reference file, not two occurrences

description: How many external symbols a file uses (or top fan-out across codebase)
purposeAndLimits: External symbol count for files; module/type references are included.

description: Count shared-symbol coupling between two files, or rank file pairs by that metric
purposeAndLimits: Shared-symbol counts; candidates for coordination review, not conceptual similarity.

description: Find every cyclic file-dependency component and show one deterministic witness for each
purposeAndLimits: Every cyclic static file component with a witness; not every simple cycle or a runtime failure.

description: Evaluate project-owned architectural boundaries and dependency rules
purposeAndLimits: Validate explicit project boundaries, allowances and limits; coverage exposes unmapped files.

semanticFixtureChecks.claim: partial policy file coverage is disclosed

description: Rank coordination hubs by incoming evidence files × outgoing cross-file callable targets
purposeAndLimits: Incoming evidence files times outgoing targets; ranking for inspection only.

description: Find symbols by SCIP kind (class, interface, enum, function, etc.)
purposeAndLimits: Compiler-indexed symbol kinds; source-only symbols depend on provider coverage.

description: Histogram of symbol kinds in the codebase
purposeAndLimits: Counts of compiler symbol kinds; not a count of domain concepts.

description: Find longest paths through the SCC-condensed file dependency graph
purposeAndLimits: Longest paths after condensing cyclic file groups; not execution depth.

description: Show a symbol's ancestry chain (method → class → module)
purposeAndLimits: Actual indexed lexical ancestors; descriptor-only invented identities removed.

semanticFixtureChecks.claim: all ancestry identities are full indexed symbols

description: Map the complete indexed call graph from one detected entry point, collapsed by file
purposeAndLimits: Static call graph from a detected ingress; rejects ordinary non-entry callables.

description: Show static may-call edges with exact/candidate evidence and explicit blind spots
purposeAndLimits: Static may-call evidence with candidate neighbors separate; nested owner and warm cache repaired.

semanticFixtureChecks.claim: three exact direct targets, no unused read

description: Conservative reverse caller/reference closure of symbols that may be impacted by a change
purposeAndLimits: Conservative reverse caller/reference closure; an affected consumer may need no edit.

description: Pre-change briefing: consumers, published API, operational roots, and explained change risk
purposeAndLimits: Consumers, published API and operational roots before a change; explained risk signals.

description: Files that change together in git history without a dependency edge — hidden coupling candidates
purposeAndLimits: Git co-change without a dependency edge; historical association is not causation.

description: Partially-completed extraction candidates: new helpers in the diff wired into some sites while similar un-migrated sites remain
purposeAndLimits: New helpers plus similar unwired sites; migration candidates need source confirmation.

description: Show definition/reference sites and incoming/outgoing static calls without value-flow claims
purposeAndLimits: Definition/reference sites plus incoming/outgoing calls; deliberately no dataflow claims.

description: Show only proved argument/parameter and bounded static-value transfers around a symbol
purposeAndLimits: Proved argument/parameter and bounded value transfers; no general heap/effect proof.

description: Slice one variable occurrence through function-local value and control dependencies
purposeAndLimits: One occurrence through local value/control dependencies; alias/delete gaps now incomplete. No general interprocedural slice.

description: Traverse legacy callee or reference-owner reachability without calling it a program slice
purposeAndLimits: Legacy caller/reference-owner reachability; retained for graph consumers, not a program slice.

description: Map changed symbols and downstream consumers from the current git diff
purposeAndLimits: Changed symbols and downstream consumers from a Git base; coverage includes attribution gaps.

description: Find repository-dead code, file-internal symbols, and implicit-usage signals
purposeAndLimits: Repository-dead and file-local evidence with implicit-use counterevidence; no automatic deletion.

description: Find imports not referenced in the same file
purposeAndLimits: Unused local imported bindings; provider coverage limits absence claims.

description: Find completely orphaned symbols (no references at all)
purposeAndLimits: Zero discovered references; unindexed/dynamic consumers may still exist.

description: Find heuristic function similarity candidates from callee fingerprints
purposeAndLimits: Function callee-fingerprint candidates; shared calls do not prove equivalent behavior.

description: Find heuristic similar-file candidates from dependency profiles
purposeAndLimits: Dependency-profile similarity; not duplicate source or equivalent modules.

description: Find heuristic duplicated React component structure candidates from JSX tags, props, events, and bindings
purposeAndLimits: Heuristic JSX structure candidates; confirm behavior, state and binding differences.

description: Find heuristic React hook extraction candidates from shared state, effects, requests, and handlers
purposeAndLimits: Shared React state/effect/request structure; extraction requires lifetime review.

description: Find heuristic large React component pressure candidates from component lines, JSX structure, and hook behavior
purposeAndLimits: Size, JSX and hooks pressure; not proof of too many responsibilities.

description: Find heuristic duplicated Vue component structure candidates from template tags, bindings, slots, and directives
purposeAndLimits: Heuristic template structure candidates; confirm scripts, directives and bindings.

description: Find heuristic Vue composable extraction candidates from shared state, effects, requests, and template bindings
purposeAndLimits: Shared Vue state/effect/request patterns; no automatic composable extraction.

description: Find heuristic large Vue view pressure candidates from template, script, style, and external script line counts
purposeAndLimits: Template/script/style size pressure, including external scripts; not a quality grade.

description: Find heuristic similar-chain candidates from dependency flows
purposeAndLimits: Dependency-flow fingerprint candidates; paths are not identical algorithms.

description: Find extraction candidates: contiguous regions whose callees are used nowhere else in the function
purposeAndLimits: Contiguous callee-isolated regions; not a proven safe extraction or local slice.

description: Find directory-locality and ancestry candidates from consumer ownership
purposeAndLimits: Consumer directory ancestry suggests placement; fixed symbol/file confusion. Business ownership needs review.

semanticFixtureChecks.claim: sum symbol not consumer filename substring

description: Ordered, batched deletion plan: graph-fact dead code plus the cascade candidates it unlocks
purposeAndLimits: Orders dead-code candidates and possible cascades; each deletion still needs usage verification.

description: Directional duplicate candidates: recent code that re-implements established callable, React, or Vue code
purposeAndLimits: Recent-to-established duplication candidates; age and similarity do not justify substitution.

description: Stale-doc candidates: code the doc references or co-changed with kept changing after the doc stopped
purposeAndLimits: Code continued changing after related docs; candidate, not proof of false documentation.

description: Speculative-generality candidates: trailing parameters no body ever uses (TS/JS)
purposeAndLimits: TS/JS trailing parameters unused in bodies; interface/callback contracts can require them.

description: Detect drift candidates: unused imports and declared architecture violations; pass --architecture for boundary context
purposeAndLimits: Unused import and explicit boundary violations; does not infer architectural intent.

description: Find heuristic wrapper candidates only called by one consumer (high false-positive rate on codebases with intentional layering/ambient types — treat as exploration, not findings)
purposeAndLimits: Retain as optional exploration only: single-consumer wrappers can be intentional and useful.

description: Find heuristic passthrough candidates that forward to one callee
purposeAndLimits: Forwarding wrappers with signature checks; layering can justify keeping them.

description: Find heuristic stale abstraction candidates with 0-1 consumers (high false-positive rate on codebases with intentional layering/ambient types — treat as exploration, not findings)
purposeAndLimits: Retain as optional exploration only: few consumers do not establish a bad abstraction.

description: Find heuristic complexity hotspot candidates from LOC x fan-in x fan-out
purposeAndLimits: LOC times fan-in/out ranking; distinct from cyclomatic/cognitive measurement.

description: Find low-cohesion candidates from backward slices: outputs whose statements never meet are separate local computations
purposeAndLimits: Disconnected local output computations; only covered local flow can support the candidate.

description: Score cheap evidence paths against the best available semantic/source oracle on sampled symbols
purposeAndLimits: Agreement between cheap and richer providers; they can share bugs. Diagnostic, not ground-truth accuracy.

description: Per-symbol complexity: branches, cyclomatic estimate, fan-in/out, callees
purposeAndLimits: Documented function-local branch/cyclomatic counts and exact/candidate callees; nested scopes repaired.

semanticFixtureChecks.claim: one conditional and three actual call targets

description: Find barrel re-exports that nobody imports through
purposeAndLimits: Unused barrel routing candidates; public/external API consumers require review.

description: Find exact duplicate small-body candidates across files
purposeAndLimits: Exact small-body token candidates; identical text can still reference different bindings.

description: Twin drift candidates: same-name (or near-name) functions across files with diverged bodies
purposeAndLimits: Same/near-name divergent bodies; similarity of names does not establish common responsibility.

description: Reachable placeholder stub candidates (throw-stub, TODO+return-default, empty body) — production callers can actually reach these; an unreachable stub is dead's job, not this one's
purposeAndLimits: Reachable stub patterns; deliberate defaults/abstract hooks need confirmation.

description: Decorative checker candidates: validate*/verify*/check*/assert*/is*/has* callables with no reachable failure exit anywhere in their body
purposeAndLimits: Checker-shaped functions lacking known failure exits; naming and external effects limit inference.

description: Test-quality candidates: assertion-free it/test bodies, a skipped-test ledger with git-blame age, and mock-echo tests that assert the same literal they stubbed into a mock
purposeAndLimits: Assertion-free, skipped and mock-echo candidates; custom helpers can encode valid assertions.

description: Find functions with near-identical type signatures (same shape)
purposeAndLimits: Near-identical type shapes; many distinct operations legitimately share a signature.

description: Review current TS/JS changes against a Git commit, including new and untracked functions
purposeAndLimits: Current TS/JS diff metrics/findings, including untracked functions; CRAP requires source-matched measured coverage.

semanticFixtureChecks.claim: missing coverage does not produce CRAP numbers

description: Index the codebase and convert to SQLite

description: Add source files skipped by upstream SCIP indexers to the SQLite documents table
purposeAndLimits: Add missing source documents; does not manufacture compiler symbols.

description: Add compiler-resolved Vue SFC references to the SQLite index using Volar
purposeAndLimits: Add compiler-resolved Vue references through isolated workers; requires the Vue tooling/provider.

description: Show index statistics
purposeAndLimits: Index statistics; they describe the indexed generation, not all current source.

description: Compiler-backed context for a symbol, file, or module
purposeAndLimits: Aggregate known symbol/file/module evidence with reusable consumer reads; no inferred task relevance.

description: Find concrete TS/JS complexity, duplication, and dependency issues without an index
purposeAndLimits: First-use TS/JS source scan for measured complexity, token duplicates and imports; no general conceptual ownership verdict.

semanticFixtureChecks.claim: cycle detected without an index-dependent graph call
